# Recurv

> Recurv is a South African payment-collections platform. It runs the full collection cycle, from digital payment authorisation through reconciliation, for membership dues, payment plans, rent, subscriptions, and similar charges.

Recurv.Tech Pty Ltd operates this site at https://recurv.tech. The signed-in product is at https://app.recurv.tech. Clickmod powers the product.

This file is a curated index for agents. Pages are HTML; there are no separate Markdown copies. Read this file, then open only the links you need. Industry pages and blog posts are published from a CMS and change without a code deploy, so use the index pages rather than assuming a fixed list of articles. For fuller context on Recurv’s service, audience, collection patterns, and workflow, see [llms-full.txt](https://recurv.tech/llms-full.txt).

Collections run on card payments and SARB-compliant EFT debit orders. Recurv is PCI DSS Level 1. Collection patterns on the home page are once-off, fixed-term, ongoing, ad hoc fees, and variable amounts. Pricing is not published; sales quotes it.

## Product

- [Home](https://recurv.tech/): Product overview, collection types, dashboard, security, and calls to action
- [Collection types](https://recurv.tech/#collection-types): Once-off, fixed-term, ongoing, ad hoc, and variable-amount collections, plus card and EFT debit-order rails
- [Industries](https://recurv.tech/industries): Index of industry pages, including schools, property, clubs, and medical payment plans
- [API](https://recurv.tech/api-docs): Product overview of the API — mandates, collections, customers, payouts, signed webhooks, and reporting. Sandbox keys and the full reference are arranged with the team
- [Guided demo](https://recurv.tech/demo): Product walkthrough videos. A short form may be required before the videos play
- [Contact](https://recurv.tech/contactus): Sales, customer support, and partnerships or press. Sales replies within one business hour
